name: Turnkey
description: Wallet and key infrastructure for agents: policy-scoped signing wallets with spending caps, allowlists and multi-party approval, operated via API, CLI or Turnkey's agent skills.

skills.name: Provision Agent Wallet
skills.description: Creates a wallet scoped for an agent with a non-root agent user and constrained API credentials.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Writes policies with spending caps, destination and contract allowlists, and multi-party approval for high-value actions.

skills.name: Sign Transactions
skills.description: Signs and broadcasts transactions on EVM, Solana, Bitcoin and other chains from policy-checked wallets.

skills.name: Monitor Agent Activity
skills.description: Reads activity status, consensus approvals and audit logs, and debugs transactions a policy denied.
